purpose: Test the already-counted eight-formula Generation 3 equity-growth family, which retains full long-only equity participation to address the cash drag observed in prior rounds.
claim_boundary: Generation 3 was suggested after earlier outputs were seen, and all market history is known. A passing result is retrospective SHADOW_ONLY after robustness, never future-profit proof.

data.provider: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint adjusted close
data.null_policy: Use only dates common to every symbol; never forward fill or splice pre-inception history.
data.bias_boundary: The fixed 2026 ETF menu creates fund-survival and menu-selection hindsight, particularly for QQQ.

execution.signal_timing: signal from adjusted closes known after close t
execution.trade_timing: queue to close t+1; first earn t+1-to-t+2
execution.cadence: fixed 21-session reviews with discovery anchor zero
execution.standalone_boundaries: charge cash-to-first-weights entry and final risky liquidation in every slice and annual-origin window

candidate_registry.formula: Every 21 sessions hold 50% SPY and equal weights in the top three original-nine sector ETFs by log(P[t-21]/P[t-252]).
Every 21 sessions hold 50% SPY and equal weights in the top three original-nine sectors by log(P[t-126]/P[t-252]).

After 756 sessions, fit each sector's alpha/beta to SPY on 504 daily log returns ending t-252, score mean/stdev of market-model residuals over return endpoints t-251 through t-21, then hold 50% SPY plus the top three sectors equally. Hold SPY before full history exists.

After 756 sessions, sort each of 12-1 momentum, 12-6 momentum, residual-sector momentum, and adjusted-close proximity to the trailing 252-session high in descending order with alphabetical ticker tie-breaks; map ordinal positions to (8-index)/8, average those four ordinal-percentile scores, and hold 50% SPY plus the top three sectors equally. Hold SPY before full history exists.
Hold 50% SPY plus 25% each in the top two of SPY/QQQ/IWM/EFA/VWO/VNQ by 12-1 momentum; if SPY is selected its weights add.
Hold 50% SPY plus 25% each in the top two of VUG/VTV/VO/VB by 12-1 momentum.
Hold RSP when at least six of the nine original sectors are strictly above their inclusive SMA200; otherwise hold SPY.

Use the 50%-SPY 12-1 sector policy, except hold 100% SPY when SPY 504-session momentum is negative and annualized 20-session volatility exceeds the 80th percentile of its prior 252 completed estimates.

selection.objective: Maximize the smaller development/validation annualized log-growth edge among candidates passing every pre-robustness gate; break an exact robust-score tie by higher validation annualized log-growth edge, then alphabetical identifier. Recent history cannot rank or break ties.
selection.recent_hard_safety_veto: After selection only, veto if 2025-2026 standalone maximum drawdown is below -20%, total return trails BIL, or drawdown is over five percentage points worse than SPY.

raw: annualized log growth exceeds SPY in development and validation
validation edge is at least 50 bp/year
median validation edge is positive in 252/504/756-session annual-origin families
at least 60% of each validation window family beats SPY
risk: validation volatility does not exceed SPY
validation drawdown is within two points of SPY
validation BIL-excess Sharpe exceeds frozen Finly and the 15% SPY volatility-target baseline by at least 0.10
validation drawdown is within two points of frozen Finly and no worse than 15%
post_selection: survives 5/10/25 bp costs and all 21 anchors
DSR probability at least 0.95 using 92 trials
fixed-candidate familywise p-value at most 0.05 for circular and moving 5/20/60-session blocks
